already-opened: An issue has already been opened from this post:
notify.expiring: The GitHub token of the "GitHub Issue from Post" plugin expires in %1 days
notify.expired: The GitHub token of the "GitHub Issue from Post" plugin has expired
error.not-configured: The GitHub issue plugin is not configured yet (repository or token missing)
error.token-expired: The GitHub token has expired — please ask an administrator to renew it
error.invalid-repo: Invalid repository — use the owner/repository format
error.invalid-expiry: Invalid expiry — enter a positive number of days or leave empty
error.request-failed: Could not reach GitHub — please try again later
admin.title: GitHub Issue from Post
admin.description: Send post content to a new GitHub issue from the post options menu.
admin.repo-help: Target repository in owner/repository format, e.g. NodeBB/NodeBB
admin.labels-help: Optional comma-separated labels added to every created issue. If the token's account has no push access to the repository, GitHub ignores labels sent over the API — in that case add the forum-labels workflow from the plugin's README to the repository and the labels will be applied by the repository itself.
admin.token-help: Personal access token with permission to create issues. Write-only: it cannot be viewed after saving. Leave empty to keep the current token.
admin.expiry-help: Number of days the token is valid from the moment it is saved. Leave empty for no expiry. Administrators are notified 10 days before expiry and again when it expires.
admin.status-not-set: No token is configured — the button is hidden from all users until a token and repository are set.
admin.status-expired: The token expired on %1 — creating issues is blocked until a new token is saved.
admin.privilege-help: Who can use the button is controlled by the regular privileges system: under Manage → Privileges select "Global Privileges", click the "Other" filter, and grant the "Open GitHub issue from post" privilege to groups or individual users.
